description: rag-plugin hooks, all routed through hooks/hook_launcher.py via a fail-open inline bootstrap (D-031). Each command runs `python3 -c <bootstrap> <name> <fallback> || python -c ... || py -3 -c ...`: the `-c` form takes no script-file argument, so an unresolved ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} / missing script can never make Python exit 2 (the only blocking code) — and the interpreter chain lets the hook run where `python3` is not the name. (1) PreToolUse Bash lock-conflict guard (GUARDED mode: its `ask`/exit code passes through, only path-resolution / unexpected errors fail open). (2) UserPromptSubmit context injector (ADVISORY, D-037) — resolves the project scope, runs a SCOPED relevance probe, and injects one compact block. Supersedes the separate retrieval-reminder (D-017/D-027) and project-focus (D-025/D-028) hooks, whose unscoped probe returned HTTP 422 on every prompt from ragtools 3.0.0 onward and therefore never injected. None of these hooks deny; advisory hooks cannot block at all.

hooks.command: python3 -c "import os,sys,runpy;r=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT');p=os.path.join(r,'hooks','hook_launcher.py') if r else '';p=p if os.path.isfile(p) else (sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '');runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__') if (p and os.path.isfile(p)) else None" lock-conflict "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook_launcher.py" || python -c "import os,sys,runpy;r=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT');p=os.path.join(r,'hooks','hook_launcher.py') if r else '';p=p if os.path.isfile(p) else (sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '');runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__') if (p and os.path.isfile(p)) else None" lock-conflict "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook_launcher.py" || py -3 -c "import os,sys,runpy;r=os.environ.get('CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT');p=os.path.join(r,'hooks','hook_launcher.py') if r else '';p=p if os.path.isfile(p) else (sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv)>2 else '');runpy.run_path(p,run_name='__main__') if (p and os.path.isfile(p)) else None" lock-conflict "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/hook_launcher.py"
